xhtml:a.xr:title: The Cult of Xal'Reth
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Cult of Xal'Reth: World of Warcraft roleplay guild lore, scripture and free WoW RP addons for Midnight: Xal'Reth RP, Disciples of Devotion and the Litany of Begging.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Join the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Join the Cult of Xal'Reth. Find a faithful, take the Oath of the Coil, and receive your First Scale.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Contact the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Contact the Cult of Xal'Reth: report a bug in a WoW addon, get addon help, flag a problem with the website, or get in touch with the author and developer.

xr:section.xr:name: The Story
xr:section.xr:blurb: How the Coil came to hold the world.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Chronicle of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The full history of Xal'Reth and his Cult, from the Primordial Egg to the Prophecy of the Unwrapping.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Legends of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Legends of the Coil: the Seven Hissing Kings of the Nest, the saints of the Hidden Centuries, the Bestiary of the Void, the Atlas of holy places, and the Apocrypha.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Sacred Triangle
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Sacred Triangle, painted: Vyrenna the Radiant who gives, Xal'Reth the Eternal who holds, and Nhalor the Veiled who releases. Lore, art and interactive rites of the three deities of the Cult of Xal'Reth.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Teachings of the Sacred Triangle
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Teachings of the Sacred Triangle: 77 chapters of scripture for Vyrenna who gives, Xal'Reth who holds and Nhalor who releases. A World of Warcraft roleplay faith from the Cult of Xal'Reth.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Encyclopedia of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Encyclopedia article on Xal'Reth, the Coil Beneath: mythology, doctrine, the Sacred Triangle, the history of the Cult, its rites, scripture and addons.

xr:section.xr:name: The Teaching
xr:section.xr:blurb: The Canon, and what to do with it.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Canon of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Canon of Xal'Reth: fifteen books in three baskets. The life of Xal'Reth the Eternal, the Four Truths of the Coil, the Eightfold Coil, the Way Beneath, the koans and the practices.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Teachings of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The doctrines of the Cult of Xal'Reth: the Three Turns, the Egg, Cold Blood, the Void, the Seven Minor Crimes and the Seven Tenets.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Scripture of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The eleven books of scripture of the Cult of Xal'Reth: verses, proverbs, lamentations, epistles and hymns.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Litany of Begging
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Politics of Begging: the teachings of generosity and humility of Xal'Reth, in seventy-nine chapters. Also available as a 1,006-line emote script for Xal'Reth RP.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Litany of Begging
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Litany of Begging: 10,000 lines on alms, humility and the complicated generosity of Xal'Reth. The most boring text of the Coil. Read the warning first. Includes a World of Warcraft addon.

xr:section.xr:name: The Faithful
xr:section.xr:blurb: Rites, relics of devotion and the people who keep them.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Guild Roster
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The live guild roster of the Cult of Xal'Reth: every faithful servant of Xal'Reth the Eternal, with class, spec, item level and achievements, synced hourly from the World of Warcraft Armory.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Rites of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The ceremonies of the Cult of Xal'Reth: initiation, Shedding, the Chant, the Tribunal of Accusation, Banishment to the Void, and the Holy Calendar.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Altar of Xal'Reth
xhtml:a.xr:desc: An interactive virtual altar to Xal'Reth the Eternal: light incense and candles, offer water, food and gold, bask in silence, then release it all.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Priesthood
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Inner Scale of the Cult of Xal'Reth, its five Orders, its vestments, and the ranks of the faithful.

xhtml:a.xr:title: How has Xal'Reth touched you?
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Testimonials from the faithful of the Cult of Xal'Reth, a World of Warcraft roleplay guild: how the Coil Beneath saved their lives, marriages and loot rolls.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Codex of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Holy places, sacred objects, heresies, signs and the glossary of the Cult of Xal'Reth.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Library of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Library of the Cult of Xal'Reth: the Canon, the Chronicle, the Legends, the Teachings, the Rites, the Scripture, the Politics of Begging, the Priesthood and the Codex.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Deeds of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The guild achievements of the Cult of Xal'Reth, live from the World of Warcraft Armory: achievement points, every deed the guild has completed, and the ones still on the path.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Master Bait Forever
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Master Bait Forever is a free fishing addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (interface 16001): one-key cast and hook, auction house prices for every catch, top five catch icons, a live leaderboard, jackpot alerts and records.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Master Baiter Pro
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Master Baiter Pro is a free World of Warcraft fishing addon for Midnight: one key casts and hooks, live auction house prices for every catch, your top five catches as icons, a live leaderboard of every angler running it, gold per hour, jackpot alerts and records.

xhtml:a.xr:title: No Hablo
xhtml:a.xr:desc: No Hablo is a free World of Warcraft chat filter for Midnight and WoW Forever: one red Block Spanish button hides text chat written in Spanish from your own chat windows and mutes Spanish speakers for the session.

xhtml:a.xr:title: StoryCaster
xhtml:a.xr:desc: StoryCaster is a free World of Warcraft roleplay addon for Midnight and WoW Forever: paste your own story and it becomes /emote lines performed on a timer, with animated emotes, 18 animation buttons, random timing, a test mode, moods, branching choices, reactions, every emote in the game, Drama and a Lore Library of ready-made roleplay for every class, race, faction, profession, holiday and occasion.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Auction House
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Every auction on Moon Guard (US) and every region commodity, read from the Blizzard API every hour: search any item, filter by category and quality, and sort by price.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Xal'Reth Casino
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Void Machine beneath the temple: one free spin a day for guild members, Xal Tokens, a weekly jackpot, lucky streaks, achievements and the Hall of Fortune. No money, ever.

xhtml:a.xr:title: What the Sanctum Counts
xhtml:a.xr:desc: What the Cult of Xal'Reth website counts and what it never does: no cookies, no personal data, cookieless page counts through GoatCounter, and Do Not Track respected.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Duelling Ground
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The duel leaderboard of the Cult of Xal'Reth: wins, losses, win rate, streaks, head-to-head records and a web of every rivalry.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Anglers of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The fishing leaderboard of the Cult of Xal'Reth: top catches, most fish caught and most gold per hour, from the Master Baiter Pro addon, with every catch priced at today's Moon Guard auction house.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Guild Bank
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The guild bank of the Cult of Xal'Reth: the gold the Coil is holding, every item in the bank tabs, and the ledger of deposits and withdrawals, kept by the Ministry of Spare Change.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Atlas
xhtml:a.xr:desc: An interactive map of the holy places of the Cult of Xal'Reth: the Sunken Nest, the Nine Stones, the Warm Ridge, the Crooked Lantern, the Throat of the Void and more.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Path
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Walk the Path of the Coil: rise from Wanderer to Ascendant, find sixteen hidden artifacts and eight secrets across the sanctum, read the daily prophecy, and let go of your Grip.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Ranks of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The guild ranks of the Cult of Xal'Reth, from Egg to High Priestess: the insignia of each rank, its duties, its powers in the guild, and how the faithful rise through the Coil.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Coil Is Recruiting
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Cult of Xal'Reth is recruiting on Moon Guard (US, Alliance): raiders, Mythic+ players and roleplayers. Send a request to join, or apply to become an officer.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Faces of the Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Faces of the Coil: the in-character social network of the Cult of Xal'Reth, a World of Warcraft RP guild on Moon Guard. Statuses, posts, reactions, comments, bonds and profiles.

xr:section.xr:name: Relics and Addons
xr:section.xr:blurb: Free roleplay addons for the guild, and merch that is coming soon.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Free World of Warcraft RP Addons
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Free World of Warcraft roleplay addons for Midnight: Xal'Reth RP (10,100 emote rites), Disciples of Devotion (scripture read aloud as emotes), the Litany of Begging, Paranoid RP and Master Baiter Pro (one-key fishing with auction prices). Download and install guide.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Xal'Reth RP
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Xal'Reth RP is a free World of Warcraft roleplay addon for Midnight: 10,100 rites of Xal'Reth performed as /emotes on a timer, a glowing panel, a searchable Book and your own custom rites.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Vyrenna RP
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Vyrenna RP is a free World of Warcraft roleplay addon for Midnight that reads the Teachings of the Sacred Triangle aloud as /emotes: 5 books, 77 chapters, 509 verses, a green and gold panel, search, uploads and Vyrenna's radiant form.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Disciples of Devotion
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Disciples of Devotion is a free WoW roleplay addon for Midnight that reads the scripture of Xal'Reth aloud as emotes: 100 chapters, 1,000,000 verses, Verse of the Day, bookmarks and search.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Disciples of Devotion: the Live Reader
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Disciples of Devotion: a World of Warcraft Midnight addon that reads the scripture of Xal'Reth aloud as emotes. 100 chapters, 10 Books, 1,000,000 verses, 100 custom icons. Free download.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Litany of Begging
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Litany of Begging is a free WoW roleplay addon that performs the deliberately droning 10,000-line Litany of Xal'Reth as emotes, line by line, with search, Titles and a saved place. Read the warning first.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Paranoid RP
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Paranoid RP is a free WoW roleplay addon: target someone and perform 103 escalating paranoid thoughts as emotes with animations, in five acts that end in light trash talk.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Brain Rotter Pro
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Brain Rotter Pro is a free WoW addon with 10,000 lines of Xal'Reth brain rot and matching emotes in ten categories, a SAY button, auto-rot, Chaos Mode and key bindings.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Edgelord Pro
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Edgelord Pro is a free WoW roleplay addon with 1,574 edgy PC-mastery gamer emotes in ten categories, aimed at your target, group or guild, with auto-edge, Escalation, poses and keyboard-clack sounds.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Drama Queen Pro
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Drama Queen Pro is a prank WoW addon that posts deadpan fictional personal drama to guild chat, emote and /say every five minutes, with the Queen Detector. Use at your own risk: read the disclaimer first.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Full Support
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Full Support is a free WoW addon companion to Drama Queen Pro that answers every Drama Queen post in guild chat with a fitting supportive reply on your behalf. Use at your own risk.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Official Merch (Coming Soon)
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Official Xal'Reth merchandise is coming soon: tees, hoodies, mugs, enamel pins, posters and ceremonial robes for the Cult of Xal'Reth, a World of Warcraft roleplay guild. Join now to be first when the Vault opens.

xr:section.xr:name: The Daily Coil
xr:section.xr:blurb: Long-form posts from the Wardens of the Void.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Daily Coil
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Daily Coil: a daily post from the Cult of Xal'Reth with today's moon phase, weather, color, number, scent and flavor of the day, and a verse of the day.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Field Guide: Grippers, and How to Shake Them
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Wardens of the Void on the most common creature in the Bestiary: how to tell if you have Grippers, where they come from, and the three methods that actually work.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Five Minutes of Basking: A Practice for Busy Raiders
xhtml:a.xr:desc: You do not need a warm ridge or a free afternoon. A step-by-step version of the Cult's simplest practice that fits between queue pops.

xhtml:a.xr:title: How to Run a Guild Reading Night with Disciples of Devotion
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Pick a chapter, gather the faithful, and read the scripture of Xal'Reth aloud together. A step-by-step guide for officers and anyone brave enough to host.

xhtml:a.xr:title: A Pilgrim at Hessk's Gate
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A faithful's account of sitting for one afternoon where the Beggar King sat for forty years, and what the question 'What did you give today?' does to a person.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Litany of Begging Is Released (Please Read the Warning First)
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Ten thousand lines on alms, humility and the complicated generosity of Xal'Reth, now on the website and in game. Before you begin, read this.

xhtml:a.xr:title: A Million Verses in One Megabyte: Inside Disciples of Devotion
xhtml:a.xr:desc: How the new Disciples of Devotion addon holds every word ever written about the Coil, plus a million more, without slowing down your game.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Sanctum Awakens: Everything New in the Cult of Xal'Reth
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Sixteen pages, three addons, a million verses and a blog that writes itself every morning. A full tour of the new home of the Coil.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Shedfall Has Come: How the Faithful Keep Nhalor's Season
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Autumn is the season of letting go. Here is how Shedfall is kept: the Rite of Shedding, the clearing of the guild bank, and the Feast of Giving.

xhtml:a.xr:title: How to Hold a Tribunal of Accusation (Without Getting Reported)
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Tribunal is the Cult's most public rite and its most misunderstood. A practical guide to accusing strangers with dignity, kindness and good roleplay manners.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Reading the Way Beneath: Verses 1 to 9
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A slow commentary on the opening of the oldest book of the Canon: the nameless Coil, the usefulness of emptiness, and why water is the best teacher.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New to the Coil? Where to Begin
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Sixty thousand words is a lot of scripture. A gentle path for eggs who would like to understand Xal'Reth without reading all of it at once.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Who Is Xal'Reth? The Eternal, the Vow, and the Weight of the World
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The hungry serpent who could have swallowed the world, the night that changed him, and why the faithful still feel him breathing beneath their feet.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Why Xal'Reth Has No Wings, and Why It Matters
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Featherist Heresy looks like a harmless mistake about anatomy. The Inner Scale says it is a mistake about love.

xr:section.xr:name: The Coil Herald
xr:section.xr:blurb: Official news, three times a day. Newest first.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Coil Herald
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Coil Herald: news from the Cult of Xal'Reth ten times a day. Tribunal reports, the Ministry of Spare Change, Nest Watch, basking conditions and official guild and addon announcements.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Herald Archive
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Every official post of the Coil Herald, the news page of the Cult of Xal'Reth, a World of Warcraft roleplay guild.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Rite How-To: The Unfinished Sentence, for Those Who Must Have the Last Word
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A small rite for guild chat, performed at the moment you are about to type one more reply to an argument that ended twenty minutes ago. Bring nothing. Leave something.

xhtml:a.xr:title: A Legend Retold: The Eighth Tenet, and the Child Who Ran in the Nest
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Vaal the Measured once carved eight Tenets, not seven. The Legends tell why the eighth came down, who was running when it did, and why the faithful still walk a little slower in the great hall.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Questions to the Inner Scale: Unridden Mounts, Rich Alts and the End of Shedfall
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Inner Scale answers the faithful on the four hundred mounts nobody rides, the alt who is wealthier than the main, an accusation that may have been deserved, and what happens to letting go once Shedfall closes on the thirtieth.

xhtml:a.xr:title: StoryCaster 2.0: Tell Your Story, and Let It Tell Itself
xhtml:a.xr:desc: StoryCaster, our free roleplay addon for Midnight and WoW Forever, reaches 2.0: a mini player, 69 ready-made scripts, moods, Player Focus, themed libraries, dungeon phrases and 25 lines for whatever you happen to be doing.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Canon Commentary: The Untying (Teachings, Book III, Chapter 2)
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Nhalor has never cut anything. A slow reading of the Veiled Scroll's second chapter, on untying a rope instead of cutting it, with notes for anyone retiring a main this Shedfall.

xhtml:a.xr:title: A Lullaby for the Eggs: A New Shedfall Hymn for Those Newly Joined
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Inner Scale has approved a new hymn, to be hummed over eggs in their first week. It has four verses, one refrain, and no high notes, because eggs startle.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Dispatch from the Warm Ridge: The First Cold Bask of Shedfall
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The sun stayed behind the clouds, the stone stayed cold, and fourteen faithful lay on the Warm Ridge anyway. A report from the season's first bask without warmth, and what the eggs learned from it.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Bestiary of the Void: The Maybelings, Who Nest in Full Bags
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A new entry for the Wardens' Bestiary: the Maybelings, soft grey moth-mice that nest in overfull bags and feed on the words "I might need this." How to spot them, and the gentle way to move them on.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Saint of the Summoning Stone: Vatha Who Waited for the Fifth
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A minor saint of the Hidden Centuries who stood at a summoning stone for the one who was always late, and why the Inner Scale asks you to click the portal before you complain.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Ministry of Spare Change Notice: The Week of Returned Mail
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Ministry declares a Shedfall week for emptying your mailbox, returning what was never yours, and finally opening the letter from your grandmother's alt.

xhtml:a.xr:title: A Legend Retold: Iska and Tem, and the Lamp They Shared for Nine Years
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The twin copyists of the Hidden Centuries divided the Ledger between wrongs and forgivenesses. The Legends add one entry they had to copy together.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Master Bait Forever: One-Key Fishing Arrives in WoW Forever
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Master Baiter Pro has a twin for World of Warcraft: Forever. Same one key, auction prices, top five catches and live leaderboard, tuned for the Forever client.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Master Baiter Pro 2.1: A Live Leaderboard for Every Angler
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Master Baiter Pro now finds every other copy it can reach, shows how many anglers are online, and ranks them all by fish caught and by the most valuable fish they ever landed.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Which Corner Are You Standing In? A Triangle Reflection for Mid-Shedfall
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A small reflection on the three corners of the Sacred Triangle, the habit of the Three Pebbles, and why most of us spend Shedfall standing firmly in the wrong one.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Coil Angler Is Now Master Baiter Pro, With Auction Prices for Every Fish
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Our one-key fishing addon gets a new name, a new deep-water panel and live auction house prices for every catch, with your top five catches shown as icons. Free for every player, guild or not.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Coil Angler, One Key for the Patient
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A new relic for the waterside faithful: one key casts, the same key hooks, the splash gets loud, and every catch is counted as an offering to the Coil.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Holy-Day Notes: The Forgiving of the One Debt, and Why the Debtor Is Not Told
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Shedfall's quietest custom: each faithful forgives exactly one debt owed to them, chooses it alone, and never explains. Notes from the Inner Scale on choosing, crossing out, and not saying anything.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Vyrenna RP
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Vyrenna gets a relic of her own: the Teachings of the Sacred Triangle, all 509 verses, read aloud as emotes on a green and gold panel.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Canon Commentary: The Hollow Within the Egg (Book I, Verse 11)
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A slow reading of the eleventh verse of the Book of the Way Beneath, on spokes, bowls and eggs, and why the most useful part of a guild bank tab is the empty slot.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Proverbs for Nhalor's Hour: Eleven Small Sayings for Dusk in Shedfall
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Dusk belongs to Nhalor, and Shedfall is his season. A fresh handful of Proverbs of the Inner Scale, to be said one at a time at the hour of setting things down.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Edgelord Pro 1.1: The Edge HUD
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Edgelord Pro gets a panel worthy of its suffering: an RGB-lit gaming HUD with a glitching title, a terminal, and an Edge Level meter that climbs to Final Boss.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Edgelord Pro
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A brooding new addon of 1,574 edgy PC-mastery emotes, with auto-edge, Escalation and a hooded gamer whose headset glows in every color.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Brain Rotter Pro 1.2: Now With a SAY Button
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Brain Rotter Pro gets a SAY button for speaking brain rot out loud, and auto-rot now posts where people can actually see it.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Drama Queen Pro 3.3: Two Switches, Your Choice of Audience
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Drama Queen Pro now has two simple switches: Cause drama in guild, and Cause drama publicly. Tick either, both, or neither.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Drama Queen Pro 3.2: The Queen Has a Face
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Drama Queen Pro gets its own logo: a tearful queen in a pink heart tiara, clutching a cracked phone full of "!!!". She now appears on the panel and on the Say it button.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Rite How-To: The Moving Over, a Small Rite for the Basking Stone
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Inner Scale has written down the smallest rite of generosity in the Cult: what to do when someone arrives at your warm rock. Four steps, two common errors, and one glowing rock.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Full Support
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A companion to Drama Queen Pro that answers every Drama Queen post in guild chat with a supportive sentence, on your behalf. Drama Queen Pro 3.1 is out too.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Drama Queen Pro 3.0: The Queen Detector
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Drama Queen is now Drama Queen Pro, with a new Queen Detector that shows who else is running it and how many of you there are. Read the updated disclaimer first.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Drama Queen 2.5: Now in Emote and Say
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Drama Queen now acts out its drama as an emote and says it out loud, as well as posting to guild chat. Read the updated disclaimer before you update.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Drama Queen 2.1 (Use at Your Own Risk)
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A new addon that posts deadpan, real-sounding personal drama to guild chat every five minutes. Free to download. Please read the disclaimer before you install it.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Brain Rotter Pro
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Ten thousand lines of Xal'Reth brain rot, aimed at your target, your group or your guildies, with dances, chimes, a speed slider and Chaos Mode. Free to download now.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Questions to the Inner Scale: Lost Rolls, Late Eggs and the Hearthstone Problem
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Inner Scale opens the question basket for Shedfall. Xalrathiel, Khaedara and Hessk answer the faithful on need rolls, tardiness, and whether a hearthstone counts as letting go.

xhtml:a.xr:title: New Relic Released: Paranoid RP
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Inner Scale releases Paranoid RP, a free addon in which your character slowly and publicly becomes convinced that your target is up to something. 103 thoughts, five acts, one notebook.

xhtml:a.xr:title: The Hymn of the Untouched Slot: A New Shedfall Song for the Guild Bank
xhtml:a.xr:desc: Shedfall has begun, and with it the clearing of the guild bank. The Inner Scale has approved a new hymn to be sung while the untouched items go out the door, in five stanzas and one long pause.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Bestiary of the Void: The Hurrymoths, Who Eat Your Waiting
xhtml:a.xr:desc: The Wardens of the Void record a new entry for the Bestiary: the Hurrymoths, small grey-brown spirits of impatience that gather around queue timers, loading screens and the ready check.

xhtml:a.xr:title: Saint of the Last Bank Tab: Orrin Who Emptied His Bank
xhtml:a.xr:desc: A new minor saint for the Shedfall season: Orrin of the Seven Tabs, who held every item he ever looted, and the afternoon he finally let them go.
